meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次回复前会自动检索之前存下的相关记忆,并在每轮对话结束后把新内容存入持久记忆;重启容器后记忆仍保留。
howto.when: 每次容器启动时自动设置记忆钩子;随后在每次回复前和每轮对话结束后触发。仅在使用 claude-code 目标的默认 Claude 环境生效。

say.text: 你还记得我们之前讨论过的那个方案吗?
say.note: 回复前会检索相关历史记忆。

say.text: 请把刚才确认的要点存入记忆。
say.note: 本轮回合结束后会保存新要点。

say.text: 按我们上次确定的偏好来回答。
say.note: 会调出上次的偏好再作答。

howto.what_en: After installation, the agent automatically checks stored memory before replying and writes new insights after each turn. Memory is kept in a dedicated directory and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: On each container start, memory hooks are registered; they fire before a response and after each turn. Hooks work only under --target claude-code on the default Claude provider.

say_en.text: Do you remember the plan we discussed earlier?
say_en.note: Relevant past context is loaded before the reply.

say_en.text: Save the point we just confirmed to memory.
say_en.note: New insights are stored after this turn.

say_en.text: Answer based on the preferences we set last time.
say_en.note: Previously saved preferences are brought up before answering.
